render_mocap_reference: run the render_reference script to visualize a humanoid following motion capture data in PyBullet GUI
draw_ground_truth_skeleton: use draw_ground_truth to overlay colored skeleton debug lines on the PyBullet simulation view
convert_h36m_to_deepmimic_json: use init_fb_h36m_dataset and rot_seq_to_deepmimic_json to convert an H3.6M dataset into DeepMimic JSON format
reset_humanoid_pose: call Reset on a Humanoid instance to reinitialize its pose from motion capture data
load_and_render_motion: use MotionCaptureData Load and Humanoid RenderReference to play back mocap frames in the simulator
